thesis: The page is the mortar analysis report: every section is a test panel on the wall, and the Flemish-bond grid is the layout that holds the evidence together.

signature.name: Flemish-Bond Test Panel Grid
signature.summary: A CSS grid alternating header-tile and stretcher-tile widths with mortar-colored gutters; numbers in headers, copy/photos in stretchers. Reused in hero mosaic, proof band, service cards, and footer.

motion.intro: Mosaic tiles drop course-by-course from bottom up via clip-path unclip, 60ms stagger; headline rises after last tile.
stories: Facade elevation pin: problem zones light in turn with fix and sample price
Mortar match live panel: CSS brick updates reactively as swatches change
motion.hover: Brass hairline grows from left via scaleX(0→1), 200ms, transform-origin left
